desc:
Displays claim volume by plan, including all claims statuses for current data set, up to two years. 
•	Placing the mouse over this widget will display the total number of claims per plan. 
•	To view information on a specific plan, select the desired plan on the widget. The widgets will adjust to reflect information for that specific plan only.  Utilizing filter features will only affect that user’s view.
•	To clear the filter from a widget, select clear selection. To restore the work session dashboard and clear any filters, select the options icon located at the top right corner of the dialog. Select Restore Dashboard.
title: Volume by Plan
